column1: # File: partitions.csv
# Path: esp32s3-tflite-camera-trigger/partitions.csv
# Role: Custom partition table for the Xiao ESP32-S3 Sense (8 MB flash).
# Layout rationale — four partitions
column2: each sized to its actual occupant:

column1: #   nvs      20 KB  — Non-volatile storage: WiFi credentials
#                     Minimum useful NVS size; enlarged post-MVP if needed.
#   otadata   8 KB  — OTA state partition. Not used by the MVP (no OTA build
#                     target defined). Included so the layout does not need
#                     to change when OTA is added post-MVP — named seam.
#   factory   2 MB  — Main firmware image. Firmware at MVP is well under 1 MB;
#                     2 MB gives headroom as TFLite Micro linkage grows.
#   spiffs    4 MB  — Model storage. MobileNetV2 SSD COCO INT8 is ~3.4 MB.
#                     4 MB provides ~600 KB headroom for model updates during
#                     development without repartitioning. Model is loaded once
#                     at boot into PSRAM inference arena; SPIFFS is not read
#                     during the inference loop.
# Flash size:                                                    0x800000
# Unused:                                                        0x1F0000 (~2 MB)
# The unused tail is intentional — not wasted
# additions (second OTA slot
# Name
nvs
otadata
factory
spiffs
